scope: Mobile dashboard navigation and form submission
environment: Synthetic staging example · Next.js / Prisma / Neon

findings.title: Eliminate sequential data fetching in tab navigation
findings.signal: Waterfall indicates two independent requests are dispatched serially.
findings.proposed_change: Fetch independent resources concurrently, preserving access checks.
findings.verification: Repeated under matched conditions; typecheck and interaction tests pass.

findings.title: Remove repeated Prisma lookups from the list API
findings.signal: Six identical select operations occur during one detail-panel open.
findings.proposed_change: Batch related reads and select only the fields the panel uses.

findings.title: Check Vercel-to-Neon region alignment
findings.signal: Elevated server-response time; region pairing not yet inspected.
findings.proposed_change: Compare runtime and database regions. Propose configuration change only with approval.

findings.title: Virtualize a long client-side table
findings.signal: Main-thread trace shows sustained layout and scripting during list expansion.
findings.proposed_change: Benchmark viewport virtualization on the existing table only.

findings.title: Reduce nonessential JavaScript loaded with the admin shell
findings.signal: Some charting dependencies appear in the initial route graph; size unmeasured.
findings.proposed_change: Measure bundle cost before moving noncritical modules behind lazy loading.

findings.title: Avoid redundant style recalculation on hover
findings.signal: One localized interaction shows extra style work, not a primary bottleneck.
findings.proposed_change: Revisit only after higher-impact items are addressed.

findings.title: Remove an obsolete duplicate status request
findings.signal: A duplicated GET appears in the Network panel when navigating back.
findings.proposed_change: Reuse the existing request result and preserve per-user cache boundaries.
findings.verification: Network request count decreased; navigation tests passed. Latency delta was not isolated.

limitations: This is a synthetic example. No repository, credentials, Vercel telemetry, or customer information was accessed.
Single findings can overlap; total savings must not be summed across cards.
Region mismatch and bundle loading remain hypotheses until measured.
